Messages.Author: Neil
Messages.Body:
Can someone tap the fragment of the book of nod if they have no cards in
their library?

"Tap to draw 2 cards from your library. Discard down to your hand size. Any
vampire can take control of the Fragment for his or her controller as a (D)
action."

Thanks,

Neil

Messages.Author: sutekh_23
Messages.Body:


I would say no as the fragment does not have a viable target to effect
i.e. a library.

Messages.Author: jeff...@pacbell.net
Messages.Body:


There is no "target" unless there is a (D) action made toward said
target.

Whenever you are directed to do something, you do it as much as you
can. If that something has a cost associated to it and you can't pay
for it, you pay as much as you can, then it fails.

So, tap the Fragment. Draw nothing (or just one if that's all you had
left). No biggie.

Jeff

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Correct. Also note: an empty library is still a library, just as an
empty vampire is still a vampire (and you can steal two blood from an
empty vampire just as you can draw two cards from an empty library --
in both cases doing nothing).
